component: Mail remote-content policy and browser regression tests

quotes.text: remote image should be blocked due to sender Block exception

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: For requests that reach this ShouldLoad branch, global allow checks content-URL DENY_ACTION and then the sender's DENY_ACTION before accepting. A rejection queues the existing observer notification while retaining the URI and context ID. The new stored-message tests directly check sender/URL permissions and image dimensions, plus a no-exception allow case; they do not assert the notification or every earlier bypass and failure path. Keep the later integrity and content-process harness phases separate from this initial patch.
title: Global remote-content allow still checks explicit deny exceptions
